reference_observation.evidence_that_images_were_read: The prompt is 7,349 tokens, not the ~209 a model returns when it never received the images, and the text transcribes real page elements.
text_first_lines: **Layout:** Top header (logo + search bar + utility links), blue primary nav bar, large hero carousel with an overlaid ticket-search form on the left, icon shortcut row below, then a 2×2 grid of promotional cards. Blue/white theme with an orange CTA button.
- Logo: 中国铁路12306 / 12306 CHINA RAILWAY
- Search placeholder: 搜索车票、餐饮、常旅客、相关规章
- Utility links: 无障碍 | 敬老版 | English | 我的12306 | 登录 注册
**Main nav:** 首页, 车票 ▾, 团购服务 ▾, 会员服务 ▾, 站车服务 ▾, 商旅服务 ▾, 出行指南 ▾, 信息查询 ▾
**Search panel (left tabs):** 车票, 常用查询, 订餐
reference_observation.note: This trial ran agent source f720337, branched from b13ee49, which predates the observer flip in PR #11/#12. Its observer is kimi-k3, not qwen3.6-flash, so this run is NOT the confirmation trial for the qwen default.
